name: hcportal_getDeviceHealth
description: Per-device health for one user, for the Usage Data user tile. Extracts the [METRICS] instrumentation (app 3.0.14+) from the user's uploaded session logs in HC.ClientErrorLog: the last [METRICS] line per session, its [METRICS:PEAKS] line, and the [METRICS:RING] block for the latest session per device. The SP extracts lines; the portal parses key=value pairs, so new app fields need no SP change.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Required. The hasher whose devices to report.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Lookback window in days, default 14, clamped to 1–90.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Only on auth/validation/runtime failure: Success=0, ErrorMessage.

rowsets.name: Devices
rowsets.description: The user's live devices, most recent login first.

columns.name: os
columns.description: HC.Device.OperatingSystem; NULL reads as 'Android' (the Android payload has no systemName)

columns.name: sessions
columns.description: Uploaded session logs in the window

rowsets.name: Sessions
rowsets.description: Up to 60 sessions with metrics across the user's devices, newest first.

columns.name: loggedAt
columns.description: Upload time (one boot after the session)

columns.name: hcVersion
columns.description: Build that wrote the log (falls back to the device's current build for pre-3.0.13 rows)

columns.name: summary
columns.description: Text after the LAST '[METRICS] ' tag: the session's cumulative key=value summary (why up fg bg cpu cpu% rss peak pss avail db docs cache disk_free loc_* app_tx app_rx req fail lat_avg lat_max dev_rx dev_tx batt state Δ drain chg lpm therm)

columns.name: peaks
columns.description: Text after '[METRICS:PEAKS]': key=value@HH:MM:SS extremes (rss_max avail_min cpu%_max lat_max batt_min pss_max)

columns.name: ring
columns.description: Latest session per device only: the [METRICS:RING] block from its tag up to the peaks line — header 'rows=N every=60s cols=…' then one CSV row per line. The trailing fragment is the peaks line's timestamp; callers drop any line starting with '['.

columns.name: appError
columns.description: HC6.ClientLogAppError: first app-error line, or NULL

columns.name: errorLines
columns.description: Count of [ERROR] lines of any kind in the session

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
summary/peaks/ring are the raw log text after the tag — the portal parses them; never pre-format them here
